1. Revision history¶

1.1. Version 3.0¶

  • Variables created in the parsing process are added as inputs to the program

1.2. Version 2.0.1¶

  • Made warning for missing variables optional

1.3. Version 2.0¶

  • Add parse module, for parsing boolean expressions into pure python objects.
  • Add support for identifiers quoted with single quotes or double quotes.
  • Version bump as several previously exposed utlity functions have been removed.

1.4. Version 1.0¶

  • Initial version. The code_api module is identical to the expression_parser module in ilock_utils 1.4.2.
